course.title: Spring Boot — Complete Practical Backend & REST API Course
course.description: A deep practical Spring Boot course covering Java project setup, dependency injection, REST APIs, DTOs, validation, JPA, database relationships, transactions, Spring Security, JWT, authorization, architecture, caching, background jobs, testing, observability, Docker and a complete student learning-platform backend.
learningOutcomes: Secure student resources with ownership checks.
Write unit, API and integration tests.
Operate applications with Actuator and logging.
Deploy Spring Boot applications with Docker.
Build course, enrollment, progress and submission APIs.
Design a production-ready learning platform backend.

notes.text: Study Method

notes.title: Spring Boot Tip
notes.text: Keep controllers focused on HTTP concerns, services focused on business rules, repositories focused on persistence, and DTOs focused on API contracts.

lessons.title: Final Capstone: Production Student Learning Platform Backend
lessons.description: Build a production-style Spring Boot backend for a real student learning platform with course content, authentication, enrollment, progress, tasks, submissions and admin management.
learningObjectives: Design scalable Spring Boot architecture.
Build REST APIs.
Model course and student data with JPA.
Validate and secure incoming requests.
Implement authentication and authorization.
Track student progress.
Handle task submissions and reviews.
Test and document APIs.
Prepare the backend for production.

notes.text: Capstone Goal

Build the backend foundation of a realistic education platform. Static course content may come from dedicated JSON files or database models, while student-specific state such as enrollment, progress and submissions is persisted through the application database.

notes.alt: Spring Boot student learning platform architecture
notes.caption: Suggested flow: client → controllers → security/validation → services → repositories → database → courses, enrollments, progress, tasks and submissions.
